Property Taxes
The Auditor-Treasurer's Office handles the calculating, billing and collection of all property taxes. The department also handles other property functions such as
Property combinations and splits
Documenting all land transfers for name and address maintenance
Special assessments
Tax forfeiture process
Settlement of collected tax dollars to the local units of government
When will my statement be sent?
Real Estate - by March 31st each year
Mobile Home - by July 15th each year
Statements will also be available online approximately 1 to 2 weeks after the mailing date.
You can look up current Property Tax Statements online.
Go to the Property Information Search
Search by parcel number, situs address, or mailing address.
Select the parcel to display tax detail.
Select the payment Scroll down until you see the Tax Statements & Links box. Click on the tax statement you would like to view and/or print.
Look up your tax statement.
For further assistance, you can call (763) 689-1644.
Mailing Address Update
If you move or have a change of address, you must notify us of the change. Property tax statements, valuation statements and other property tax notifications will not be forwarded. Please visit Property Statement Address Change Form to submit your corrected mailing information.
Moving or Selling a Mobile Home?
If you are planning to move or sell your mobile home, you must have a Tax Release Letter signed by the Isanti County Auditor-Treasurer’s Office stating there are no taxes owing on the mobile home.
The Certificate of Title must be accompanied by the Tax Release Letter at any Minnesota Department of Motor Vehicle office when making the transfer. The closest location is the Cambridge Deputy Registrar .
